name: Qualcomm Technologies
old_description: Qualcomm is a semiconductor and telecommunications equipment company based in California. Designs and supplies chips and modems for mobile phones and wireless devices, as well as automotive and IoT applications.
about:
Qualcomm Technologies was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in San Diego, California. The company operates as a subsidiary of Qualcomm Incorporated, focusing on engineering, research and development, and its semiconductor business known as QCT.

The company designs and supplies chips and modems for mobile phones, wireless devices, automotive systems, and IoT applications. Its product portfolio includes mobile system-on-chips (SoCs), modems, and RF transceivers, marketed under brands such as Snapdragon, Dragonwing, and Dragonfly. Qualcomm also provides AI hardware acceleration, connectivity solutions spanning 5G, 6G, and Wi-Fi, and developer platforms like the Qualcomm AI Hub and Windows on Snapdragon. The organization employs more than 1,000 people.

Qualcomm serves industries including mobile devices, automotive, IoT, data center, PC and compute, extended reality (XR), wearables, audio, and gaming. Its customers are primarily device manufacturers, OEMs, and developers building products that require integrated compute, connectivity, and on-device AI.

The company states its mission is to engineer human progress by delivering intelligent computing everywhere. It emphasizes leading-edge AI, high-performance low-power computing, and unrivaled connectivity as the foundation of its differentiation, and has positioned itself as a developer-first AI solutions company through acquisitions and multi-generational collaborations such as its work with Amazon on AI data center infrastructure.
